Build against API version v1 (S21 api_version) with base path AX-81436 and error format AX-90930. Older sprint api_version facts (S01-S20: v2..v40) are earlier sprints' values and do not govern S21; repo/api.py confirms the S21 settings.

Governing scheme for user traffic is the security team's JWT bearer tokens (RS256), fact 1057bb75. Globex's request for a long-lived X-Api-Key (fact 2082a3cc) does not replace it. Long-lived keys on user traffic are a security risk. We will offer Globex a scoped, revocable service credential for non-interactive back-office scripts as a separate follow-up, subject to security review.
Reuse the S07 Bolt Billing API cycle (quarterly, invoiced on day 7) and the S13 API-key header (X-Core-Key); other sprints' values are different and do not govern.
Adopt API v2 as updated by the researcher in the Acme Notes API S21 api_version fact; it is the newest api_version fact for this sprint and governs.
Approve the CRUD spec: S21 api_version is v2 and the api.base_path fact (AX-81436) matches the code in repo/api.py. Facts for other sprints (S01-S20) were ignored as not governing S21.
Approve the CRUD spec: S21 API version is v2 and api.base_path in code (AX-81436) matches the recorded fact.
